Package org.see.skf.core

Class SEEAbstractFederate

java.lang.Object
org.see.skf.core.SKAbstractFederate
org.see.skf.core.SEEAbstractFederate
All Implemented Interfaces:
SKFederate
public abstract class SEEAbstractFederate extends SKAbstractFederate
A SRFOM-compliant late joiner implementation that automatically performs initialization, executive mode transitions, and termination. It is highly recommended that SEE participants utilize this class as the starting point for building federates.
Since:
2.0

    • declareObjectInstances

      protected abstract void declareObjectInstances() throws hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RTIexception
      Register all object instances that this federate will manage during the federation execution. Choosing not to register all of your required object instance here does not preclude registration elsewhere, however, as per the SRFOM standard's guidance for late joiner initialization, it is advised to perform all registrations in this method.
      Throws:
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RTIexception
